home.title: 24×7 ON Court, Kollam
home.description: Cause lists, case search, certified copies and public court data for the 24×7 ON Court in Kollam, Kerala.
home.heading: Taking court to the people
home.intro: Launched by the High Court of Kerala in Kollam in November 2024, 24×7 ON Court began with cheque dishonour cases. It brings court information and services within easier reach.

home.services.heading: How can we help you today?

home.causeList.heading: Today's cause list
home.causeList.body: See matters listed before the court and follow the hearing display for the day.
home.caseSearch.heading: Find your case
home.caseSearch.body: Check case status, hearing dates, and case details. Search by CNR or case number.
home.copies.heading: Certified copies
home.copies.body: Request certified copies of case documents or track an existing application.

home.about.heading: Court access, made more direct.
home.about.body1: The first 24×7 ON Court was launched by the High Court of Kerala in Kollam in November 2024, beginning with cheque dishonour cases.
home.about.body2: This website brings public court information and online services together in one place.
